09/02/2020: Logger Setup                                                 [1400] 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program: obl-bbab.cr1 
                                      obl => Station Id (onekama) 
                                        b = MI (state network) 
                                        b = CR616 (soil moisture) 
                                        a = HMP45C (air temp / rh) 
                                        b = LWS-L (leaf wetness) [both] 
                                      cr1 => CR1000 (logger / logger program type) 
 
            - Now able to collect raw weather data.
